column1: # X-SAMPA -> IPA, for DoReCo's phone tiers (ph@...), which are written in
# letters to it). From John Wells's X-SAMPA chart. A phone is read longest
# match first, so "t_h" is t + aspiration and "|\|\" one lateral click; a
# symbol not listed here is reported by lana-bench as unmapped, not guessed.
# Diphthongs ("eI", "@U") are two symbols in DoReCo and come out as two letters.
# --- plosives (affricates are two symbols, as ZIPA writes them too)
